Your voice goes straight from this phone to xAI\'s Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, about $0.10 per hour of speech, billed to your xAI account. Your Mac never hears it. Without a key, the phone\'s own recognizer stands in: free, but weaker with code.

Pick English, or another language xAI formats, to get paths and code written the way you\'d type them.
People, products and your own tools, up to 50 characters each. They go with every recording.
